feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.reason: Between the merge and 2025-08-07, upstream changes to queue_consumer.py (#95753, #95919, #95942, #95943) left SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.submit the same where it matters: it still calls decoder(message.payload) (decode_payload asserts not FilteredPayload) before the None check, and the except fallback only completes offsets when message.value is a BrokerValue. So filtered DLQ-stale messages kept leaving their offsets uncommitted. PR #97340 ('Remove thread-queue-parallel mode and related code', 2025-08-07) deleted queue_consumer.py and the thread-queue-parallel wiring in result_consumer.py and consumers/__init__.py, saying the mode was unused and had not helped much. It did not target this bug. Today's master has no queue mode; decode_payload still asserts, but only the serial, parallel and batched-parallel modes remain.
